code: const fonts = await figma.listAvailableFontsAsync(); return {editorType:figma.editorType, pages:figma.root.children.map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name})), nodes:figma.currentPage.children.map(n=>({id:n.id,name:n.name})), fonts:fonts.filter(f=>/Noto Sans KR|Noto Serif KR|Noto Sans CJK|Pretendard|Nanum|Inter/.test(f.fontName.family)).map(f=>f.fontName).slice(0,80)};
